title: Account
description: Financial account record for a user, tracking account number, balance, currency, account type, and status. Used for banking, payment, and financial management systems.

id.description: Unique identifier for the account record

account_number.description: Unique account number or identifier for the financial account

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who owns this account

balance.description: Current account balance in the account's currency

currency.description: ISO currency code for the account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

type.description: Account type (e.g., checking, savings, credit, investment, wallet)

status.description: Account status (e.g., active, inactive, frozen, closed, pending)
